title: One of my Main Dreams is a Library
content: So I only found out about Mall World and I thought it'd be fun to see if anyone recognises my Library i've been dreaming of this place for *years*. It's a huge rounded multistory building. My dream always starts inside it. It is all grey stone worn smooth with age and the shelves are build into the stone with pale driftwood branches making up the shelves. There is no ceiling to the round building instead high, high up past the countless floors is a round glimpse of the sky that is always cloudy with patches of blue sky peeking through. The Books are all bound in leather with goldleaf making up the titles, but it's not normal books. It's the stories of peoples lives, past, present and future. I can read them all I want for hours on end sitting on the various rugs scattered about. However whenever I reach my own books and try to read them someone comes up behind me and tells me i'm not supposed to be here and I waken up. I just figured it'd be interesting to see if anyone else recognises this.
